name: @btkulka/trellis-client
description: TRELLIS.2 image-to-3D through a dedicated ComfyUI: check and download the weights, start the server guarded for a small machine (one at a time, free-memory floor, half the cores, low priority), turn ComfyUI's own template into an API prompt and run it (an image, or a text prompt drawn as a concept image first) to a vertex-painted GLB, and read a GLB into OBJ files split by colour for TouchDesigner, Blender or a game. Rents a bigger GPU on RunPod for what an 8 GB card cannot hold (rent: plan and price first, a budget, terminated when done). Paths and URLs come from the app. Node only; ESM and CommonJS.
